title: Jev developer TypeSafe AI raised ~$870M led by a16z at a $7.5B valuation with Sequoia and angel investors also participating; ~33% of the Fortune 500 use Jev (Bloomberg)
commentary: A model that went viral 'only a few weeks ago' just raised $870M at $7.5B — a16z and Sequoia apparently don't need a product cycle anymore, just a viral moment and Fortune 500 logo drops.
